confidence_notes: Koh Lanta price indexes support the meal, coffee and beer estimates but show limited or variable data. Cocktail and wine-glass prices are approximate multiples of local draft beer; July accommodation prices are holistic low-season estimates.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink estimates use Koh Lanta cost-of-living aggregates. Accommodation is modeled on low-season Thai Andaman resort and guesthouse markets, with Krabi and Ao Nang as broad regional context.
